text:
sam: Quick: thinking about adding a lightweight 'bundle_label' + 'compat_sentinel' pair to rollout metadata so client resolvers can pick fallbacks without fetching full manifests. Anyone have objections?

anya: +1 in principle. We should define what 'compat_sentinel' encodes — API surface compatibility vs runtime (quant/hw) compatibility.

kevin: Agree with anya. Also concerned about label explosion if we bake too many orthogonal bits into a single label. Maybe keep bundle_label small (family:variant) and put more detailed attrs in a compact bitmask like 'compat_sentinel'.

maria: Ops note: migration must include a deprecation window and telemetry hooks when client falls back. Suggest fields: deprecation_date, migration_window_days, fallback_ping=true. Also add soft_pin vs hard_pin semantics.

sam: Good points. My rough proposal:
```json
{
  "bundle_label": "llama2-13b/dense",
  "compat_sentinel": "cpu:int8|kv-v2|api-v1",
  "compat_level": "backward-compatible|minor",
  "pin_mode": "soft",
  "deprecation_date": "2026-09-01",
  "fallback_chain": ["llama2-13b/int8","llama2-13b/fp16"]
}
```
This keeps human-readable label + compact sentinel for quick matching. Resolver can check label first then sentinel bitmask for exact runtime compatibility.

deploy-bot: schema-registry: submitted schema v2 for review -> https://internal/schemas/rollout/v2 :white_check_mark:

kevin: Two tradeoffs: (1) clients need to parse sentinel — must be stable format (we should standardize delimiter and fields). (2) runtime routing: if we use sentinel bits like kv-v2, older routers need a shim or fail-open. So we need a compatibility policy.

anya: On format: prefer pipe-delimited key:value pairs in sentinel, documented, with ordering not significant. E.g. 'hw:int8|kv:2|api:1'. Also include a sentinel_version field so we can evolve parser.

maria: Also: telemetry: emit event when client chooses fallback with fields {requested_bundle_label, chosen_bundle_label, reason}. Ops can then alert when fallback rate > threshold.

sam: Sounds like consensus: add sentinel_version, keep bundle_label tight, sentinel for quick match, and fallback telemetry + deprecation window. I'll update the RFC and add a small client shim proposal for older resolvers.

kevin: One more nit: do we allow wildcards in bundle_label (eg 'llama2-*') for routing rules? Could be useful for gradual rollouts. Document wildcard semantics carefully (prefix-only).

anya: +1 for prefix wildcards, but disallow suffix globs to keep resolver cheap.

maria: I'll draft an ops playbook for deprecations that references these fields and includes the telemetry thresholds.

sam: Awesome — follow-up PR incoming for schema v2 and a prototype resolver shim. Thanks all. :rocket:
